goals.notes: I believe in the AI revolution. I am a novice trader with not much history of success. I’d rather trade on high conviction stocks with strong growth outlooks, with some calibrated risks on stocks that could balloon, that tie into my belief in AI. I would rather not sink additional capital in if I don’t have to. I am okay to rebalance my portfolio to align with my goals. I can add capital if needed, but am already down 2 grand in loses this year. Don’t be afraid to make bold calls based on research and technicals that could find us a diamond in the rough type stock that explodes.

thesis: Grow $12,154 to $20,000 in two years (~28%/yr) by rotating overbought SGOV and idle cash into leading AI compounders on weakness, while hard-capping speculative miner IREN at 10% and cutting losers mechanically.

No NVDA adds within two days of its Aug 26 2026 earnings; hold the ~$970 lot and reassess after guidance.
Hard-cap IREN at 10% ($1,215); set a stop ~15% below today given the -34% loss and critical drawdown alert—cut if breached.
AMD leads momentum (RSI 50.9, uptrend, +130% YTD per Jul 2026); add only on a volume-confirmed bounce, risking ≤$182.
AAPL sits in a 52-week-high breakout zone (RSI 62); add on a volume-backed new-high close with a stop under the base.
Prefer GOOGL near $371 (RSI 56, not extended) over PANW $348 (RSI 73.7, >2 ATR—chase forbidden); risk ≤$182.
long_term: Build a core of 6-8 AI compounders—NVDA, AVGO, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL—held through volatility and added to on 200-day tests.
Trim tail positions (MELI, NET below-trend) to fund leaders; concentrate conviction rather than spreading across 13 thin lots.
Keep IREN and any low-float speculation as a separate <10% trade sleeve with predefined exits and trailed stops.
Reinvest SGOV yield and trimmed gains into leaders whenever the S&P holds above its 200-day (~7,470, Jul 2026).
Target $20,000 by mid-2028 (~28% annualized) via compounding leaders and disciplined risk—no reliance on new outside capital.
guardrails: Risk ≤1.5% of book (~$182) per new position; size = risk dollars / distance to predefined stop.
IREN/Compute Power hard-capped at 10%; any single non-core position capped at 8% of the book.
If the S&P 500 loses its 200-day (~7,470), halve new-position size and raise cash toward 20%.
Cut every position at its stop mechanically; never average down a broken thesis (MSFT -10.3%, IREN -34%).
No new entries within two days of a holding's earnings; NVDA reports Aug 26 2026—flagged.
milestones: By Aug 26 2026: SGOV trimmed to ≤10%, cash redeployed, portfolio holding ≥$12,500 pre-NVDA earnings.
By year-end 2026: book ≥$14,000 (~15% H2 gain) with top-5 concentration below 50%.
By mid-2027: ≥$16,000, and IREN either reclaimed above cost basis or already cut per its stop.
By mid-2028: reach the $20,000 target (~28% annualized); pause new risk if drawdown exceeds -20%.
